final: WITH pairs AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as pair_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), total AS (SELECT SUM(pair_count) as total FROM pairs), pairs_share AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_count, (p.pair_count * 100.0 / t.total) as share FROM pairs p, total t) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_count) as avg_count_per_pair, AVG(share) as avg_share_per_pair FROM pairs_share GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind
